content.comment_body: Hello team, I need some help. I'm trying to add a new [product_name] to a network of three older [product_name] modules. In runtime advanced ([version_no]), I keep seeing repeating system errors: "Connection established", "Connection disconnected", and this cycle continues just for the new [product_name]. Any advice would be appreciated. Thanks!
Have you installed the latest firmware ([version_no])?
No, is it possible to obtain it?
You should update the firmware for the [product_name] and also apply service pack 1 for [product_name] [version_no].
Thank you for the suggestion. I will report back.
It worked! Thank you for your help.

analysis.insight_summary: A user experienced ongoing connection issues while integrating a new [product_name] into a network with older modules, using the runtime advanced feature. The connection repeatedly dropped and reestablished for the new device only. Applying a firmware update and software service pack resolved the problem, emphasizing the significance of keeping device firmware and configuration software up to date for stable network integration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable and continuous communication across a network of both old and new [product_name] modules, with new devices integrating smoothly and any errors reported clearly and with actionable information.
